name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: PMSBY is a one-year renewable personal-accident-insurance scheme that offers cover for death or disability due to accident.
benefits: The official Department of Financial Services FAQ lists Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death or certain total and irrecoverable disabilities, and Rs. 1 lakh for certain partial permanent disabilities. The stated annual premium is Rs. 20 per member, subject to current scheme terms.
eligibility: Eligible participating bank or post-office account holders may subscribe subject to current scheme terms. Confirm age, account, and other conditions with the participating institution.
documents: The participating bank or post office can confirm the current consent, account, and identification requirements.
application_process: Enrol through a participating bank or post office account and provide the required auto-debit consent under the current scheme process.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Any bank or post office account holder aged 18 to 70 years
